title: FairnessIndex
description: Computed fairness index quantifying measurement symmetry between two benchmark targets.

error_symmetry.description: Symmetry score for error rates between the two targets. 1.0 = both below 0.5% error; 0.0 = either above 1.0% error. Weight: 0.3.

latency_symmetry.description: Symmetry score across latency percentile pairs (p50/p75/p90/p95/p99). 1.0 = max normalised diff < 10%; 0.0 = max normalised diff > 50%. Weight: 0.4.

throughput_confidence.description: Confidence score derived from the throughput ratio (min/max). 1.0 = ratio > 0.9; 0.5 = ratio < 0.7. Weight: 0.2.

composite_score.description: Weighted composite fairness score: 0.3*error_symmetry + 0.4*latency_symmetry + 0.2*throughput_confidence. Weights deliberately sum to 0.9; 0.1 reserved for future metadata_symmetry metric.

interpretation.description: Human-readable interpretation of composite_score: highly_fair >= 0.85, fairly_comparable >= 0.70, moderate_asymmetry >= 0.50, unsuitable < 0.50.

computed_at.description: UTC timestamp when this index was computed.

targets.description: Exactly two target_id strings identifying the compared targets.

asymmetry_notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about detected or declared asymmetries.
